snapshot.name: clubs
snapshot.sql: SELECT name, name_key, (SELECT l.country_code || '-' || l.city_code FROM location_codes l WHERE l.id = c.founding_location_code_id) AS city_code, founding_address, license_pricing::text AS license_pricing, license_monthly_minor, license_yearly_minor, currency, default_players_per_court, default_entrance_fee_minor, description, court_rules, post_template, logo_ref, self_check_in_enabled, source_command_id, invite_code ~ '^[ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{10}$' AS invite_code_is_ten_unambiguous_characters, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM clubs c ORDER BY name, source_command_id

snapshot.name: club_accounts
snapshot.sql: SELECT (SELECT c.name FROM clubs c WHERE c.id = a.club_id) AS club, username, auth_subject IS NOT NULL AS has_subject, (provisioned_at IS NOT NULL) = (auth_subject IS NOT NULL) AS provisioned_with_a_subject, provisioned_at, disabled_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM club_accounts a ORDER BY username

snapshot.name: club_entitlements
snapshot.sql: SELECT (SELECT c.name FROM clubs c WHERE c.id = e.club_id) AS club, effective_term_id IS NULL AS no_term, effective_access_ends_at, current_expiry_cycle_id IS NULL AS no_cycle, refreshed_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM club_entitlements e ORDER BY 1

snapshot.name: club_license_terms
snapshot.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS terms FROM club_license_terms

snapshot.name: admin_audit_events
snapshot.sql: SELECT a.id, a.actor_admin_id, a.action, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.source_command_id, a.occurred_at, a.metadata, (SELECT c.name FROM clubs c WHERE c.id::text = a.target_id) AS target_club FROM admin_audit_events a ORDER BY a.action, a.target_type, a.source_command_id NULLS FIRST, a.occurred_at, a.metadata::text, 9

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT id FROM player_notifications ORDER BY id
